name: Example kit (format) — replace it with your brand
source: Format example. Write kits/<your-brand>.json with the colors and fonts the owner confirmed in facts.md.

caption._note: style 'stroke': bare text with outline; emphasis words (keywords + super words) bold, x1.25, path colour with the kit contrast colour as outline. style 'box' (v5–v7): flat blocks.

rules: One path colour per shot; never two on screen at once.
Only the CTA carries a border and hard shadow.
Motion is mechanical: one curve, durations in multiples of 120 ms, nothing bounces.
Space Grotesk stands in for Everett (the kit's declared open substitute).
